# Upstream emulator sources (pristine)

Downloaded 2026-11-22 with the `gh-accelerated-download` skill
(prefix `https://gh-proxy.org/`; direct GitHub access is blocked here).
Kept **unmodified** so the emulator can be re-synced without diffing against a
hand-edited copy.

## The sound-quality reference: libsidplayfp + reSIDfp

| tree / archive | upstream | notes |
|---|---|---|
| `libsidplayfp-3.1.2/` + `.tar.gz` | release `v3.1.2` | **release tarball, not the git archive** — `psiddrv.bin`, `sidplayer1.bin`, `sidplayer2.bin` are generated by `xa65`+`od` and only shipped in releases |
| `libresidfp-1.3.0/` + `.tar.gz` | release `v1.3.0` | reSIDfp is a separate project; libsidplayfp finds it via `pkg-config libresidfp >= 1.0.0` |
| `libsidplayfp-master/` + `.zip` | git master | for source reading only — will not build (no `.bin` files) |
| `libresidfp-main/` + `.zip` | git master | same caveat |

Static libraries land in `../local/lib` (`libsidplayfp.a`, `libresidfp.a`),
headers in `../local/include`. Build steps and the three pitfalls (tarball vs
git archive, msys64 bash instead of Git Bash, the harmless libtool warning) are
in `../../docs/libsidplayfp构建.md`.

Reference renderer: `tools/lsfpref.cpp` → `build/lsfpref.exe` (`make ref`).
Same tune, 20 s, same file:

| engine | drum transients (10 ms windows, >3x) |
|---|---|
| libsidplayfp + reSIDfp | **55** |
| WebSid | **0** (`digi type=0 NONE`) |

That is why WebSid is not the standard.

## WebSid

| tree / archive | upstream | notes |
|---|---|---|
| `websid-master/` + `.zip` | `wothke/websid` master | 14 sources in `src/`; `src/sid.cpp` already carries the `#ifdef RPI4 recordPokeSID(SYS_CYCLES(), reg, value)` capture hook |

Linked by the offline tools from `../websid/` (a copy of `websid-master/src`
plus a MinGW `win/compat.h` shim). Useful only for its cycle-exact intra-frame
timestamps; its digi handling is not trustworthy.

**Why not the modizer copies:** `Reference_Project/.../modizer-master-20260408/libs/websid`
and `.../libsidplayfp` are patched for modizer (`//TODO: MODIZER changes start / YOYOFR`,
`#include "../../../../src/ModizerVoicesData.h"`, `vgm_last_vol[...] = env_out;//YOYOFR`,
WebSid's filter split into `filter6581.cpp` / `filter8580.cpp`). modizer's `sid.cpp`
is 988 lines against upstream's 794. They stay useful as behaviour references only.
